exposure.needed: which users or service accounts read pod logs and whether their effective RBAC policy (including built-in roles) grants them log access

consequence.statement: With the new default, access to logs is RBAC-enforced; users whose RBAC policy does not grant log access may now be denied logs that were previously readable when enforcement was not the default.
consequence.remediation: Review the Argo CD RBAC policy (argocd-rbac-cm policy.csv) and grant log access to users or roles that need to read logs.

assertion.statement: Argo CD 3.0.0 turns on RBAC enforcement for logs by default, a breaking change flagged "feat!".
